Step 7 of the human IT ticketing workflow: act as the IT specialist to produce a root cause and customer-safe solution for an escalated ticket.

## Layout

```text
skills/investigate-specialist-solution/
├── SKILL.md
├── README.qmd
├── install.sh
└── scripts/
    └── investigate_specialist_solution.py
```

## Install

```bash
bash skills/investigate-specialist-solution/install.sh
```

## Usage through Claude

> "What did the specialist find for TKT-00042?"

Claude reads `SKILL.md`, verifies the escalation row exists, runs the script, and reports the root cause + solution + confidence.

## Direct CLI

```bash
uv run python skills/investigate-specialist-solution/scripts/investigate_specialist_solution.py --ticket-id TKT-00042
```

The script appends one row to `data/working/specialist_solutions.csv` and writes an action-log entry.

## Public functions

- `load_investigation_context(data_dir, out_dir, ticket_id)` — loads ticket, escalation, specialist, systems dictionary; raises `LookupError` if no escalation.
- `build_diagnostic_plan(context)` — list of diagnostic steps for the category.
- `infer_root_cause(context)` — `{root_cause, evidence_reviewed}`.
- `build_solution_summary(context, root_cause)` — customer summary, customer action, confidence (lower when missing-info flag was set), follow-up flag.
- `build_solution_row(context)` — full row.
- `write_specialist_solution(out_dir, solution)`.
- `main(argv)` — CLI. Exits 2 on missing data, 3 on missing escalation.

## Determinism

Solutions come from per-category templates (login_access, password_reset, billing_account, software_bug, hardware_issue, network_connectivity, email_calendar, data_reporting, security_request, other). The script never invents customer-specific facts; it produces a stable, customer-safe summary plus a clearly-labeled `customer_action_required`. Confidence = baseline-by-seniority × (0.85 if missing-information was flagged at escalation else 1.0).

## Refusal behavior

The script refuses to investigate when:

- there is no `escalation_decisions.csv` row for the ticket (route to `escalate-to-specialist` first), or
- the escalation references an unknown specialist id.

## Test

```bash
uv run pytest tests/skills/test_investigate_specialist_solution.py -v
```
